# jenius Systems

> A one-operator AI-systems studio run by an accountant with a real estate private equity
> background who is using AI to replace the day-to-day work of the job: one human who knows the
> finance work sets direction, a fleet of AI agents designs, builds, tests, and reviews the
> software. Each system is labeled with its true status.

Everything listed is real; anything private, in build, or in-rebuild is labeled as such.

## The day job, automated

- [construction draw management — case notes](https://jeniussystems.ai/construction/): a construction
  draw management platform (PDF+OCR invoice intake, approval routing, dual budgets, draw packages)
  for a real-estate investment firm's construction team, self-hosted on hardware the firm controls.
  Private pilot; logins not available.
- accounting close (in build, no public page): automation and tracking for the accounting close.
- SALT exposure (in build, no public page): a state and local tax app that quantifies the tax
  exposure for an entire portfolio, organizes the data behind it, and guides how to reduce it.
- [The Fleet — architecture sandbox](https://jeniussystems.ai/sandbox/): a sanitized architecture
  overview of the studio's self-hosted fleet of AI agents (mail, health, calendar, concierge and
  more) behind one hardened gateway; the fleet is currently being rebuilt for its second iteration.

## Off the clock (games)

- [couch critters](https://games.jeniussystems.ai/): a co-op party platformer inspired by TeamO's
  PICO PARK, played on one shared screen with phones as gamepads (join by QR code). Live and free to play.
- [kart rush](https://kart.jeniussystems.ai/): a living-room kart racer; the TV runs the race and
  phones are the steering wheels (tilt to steer, flick to drift), up to four drivers split-screen
  with AI filling the grid. Live and free to play.

## Notes

- The public site carries no live operational data; the fleet overview is descriptive only.
- There is nothing to sign up for and nothing for sale here.
